rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: North end of kerb beside bush, nearest home about 22 m away.
reasons: Bush beside kerb at north end
Nearest dwelling about 22 m, same side
Cars park just north; steep about 4-5%

drivers.seclusion: Bush and trees to the north-west; nearest dwellings 22 m (at 19 m) on the same side and 31 m (at 0 m); houses to the south are 7-8 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a gravel and dirt edge by the bush where cars pull off; room to stop clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along the kerb just north of the ring, so a van would blend in.

flags: Steep at this end: about 4.7%, 11% max further down
Houses 7-8 m away from 22 to 45 m along
Section is near the line start; parking continues beyond it
sun_shade: Heavy tree cover on the west and north; open to the afternoon sun is blocked by canopy, morning sun over the road.

best_section.where: West kerb of Taringa Parade at the north end, where the houses stop and the bush begins
